latest.title: A Smooth Counterexample to the Trautman Conjecture
latest.abstract: The Trautman conjecture asserted that a smooth three-dimensional CR manifold admitting a nowhere-zero closed section of its canonical bundle must be locally embeddable in $\mathbb{C}^2$. We modify a standard construction of nonembeddable smooth strongly pseudoconvex CR 3-manifolds so that the condition of having a nowhere-zero closed section of the canonical bundle is preserved, thus providing a strongly pseudoconvex counterexample to the Trautman conjecture.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 构造光滑、强拟凸、不可局部嵌入的三维 CR 流形，同时保留典范丛存在处处非零闭截面的条件，从而否定 Trautman 猜想。
techniques: 强拟凸 CR 三流形
非嵌入标准构造的扰动
latest.breakthrough: 给出光滑范畴中的直接反例，说明“非零闭典范截面”不足以推出局部嵌入，解决了明确的长期猜想。
latest.limitations: 稿件标注为初步版本；反例机制及闭截面条件保持的关键计算需要专家复核。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者披露反例构造通过 ChatGPT Plus 实验发现；模型还生成初稿并参与校对，作者独立检查全部计算与论证。
latest.priorityReason: 以具体构造关闭一个清晰猜想，结论强且概念影响直接。
